title: Answer
description: One recorded answer to a questionnaire question. Written to init/product/answers/<question>.md (the file body IS the answer text the wizard renders). The record-answer transition writes one per invocation; the slug matches the question's filename stem so the wizard joins question and answer.

question.description: The question slug being answered — the filename stem under init/product/questionnaire/ (e.g. 01-audience). The answer is written under the same stem in init/product/answers/.

answer.description: The recorded answer text — the entire file body the wizard renders. (`text`/`response` are accepted as aliases.)

text.description: Alias for `answer` — the recorded answer text.

response.description: Alias for `answer` — the recorded answer text.
